page_title: ENG 0-0 USA | England v USA 25/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' What a chance that is! Harry Kane (England) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
90+2' Yunus Musah (USA) makes a rough challenge and Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul.

90+1' Harry Maguire (England) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+1' Kieran Trippier (England) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+1' Jack Grealish (England) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. England will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A clumsy foul by Christian Pulisic (USA) and Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle.
89' Shaquell Moore (USA) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

87' That didn't go as planned! Marcus Rashford (England) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Matt Turner, who easily kept it out.
86' Shots on target – 1:1.
85' The free kick is taken by Luke Shaw (England), but ball is cleared.
84' Shaquell Moore (USA) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
83' Gregg Berhalter has decided to substitute Haji Wright and he is replaced by Joshua Sargent (USA).
83' It's time for a substitution. Giovanni Reyna (USA) comes on in place of Timothy Weah.
80' Shaquell Moore (USA) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Valenzuela blows for a foul.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bukayo Saka leaves the pitch and Marcus Rashford (England) comes on.
77' Gregg Berhalter prepares a substitution. Sergino Dest is replaced by Shaquell Moore (USA).
77' Substitution. Weston McKennie leaves the pitch and is replaced by Brenden Aaronson (USA).
76' Bukayo Saka (England) is adjudged offside.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:10.
73' Sergino Dest (USA) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
73' The England players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
70' The attendance is 68463.
68' Gareth Southgate has decided to make a change. Jack Grealish (England) replaces Raheem Sterling.
68' Substitution. Jude Bellingham will be replaced by Jordan Henderson (England).
67' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:7.
65' Christian Pulisic (USA) is about to take a corner kick.
64' Christian Pulisic (USA) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
63' Mason Mount (England) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Christian Pulisic (USA) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
61' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
61' Christian Pulisic (USA) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
60' A cross from Antonee Robinson (USA) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
59' Christian Pulisic (USA) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
59' Christian Pulisic (USA) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Timothy Weah (USA) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
54' Timothy Weah (USA) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
53' Timothy Weah (USA) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Bukayo Saka (England) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' Tyler Adams (USA) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul.
49' The ball rebounds out to Weston McKennie (USA) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
49' Haji Wright (USA) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Antonee Robinson (USA) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Jesus Valenzuela has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Kieran Trippier (England) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

45+1' Mason Mount (England) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Matt Turner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Matt Turner doesn't have to worry about this one. Luke Shaw plays a pass into the feet of Bukayo Saka (England), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
45' Jude Bellingham (England) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
44' Luke Shaw (England) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matt Turner, who smothers the ball.
43' Sergino Dest sends a terrific cross into the box. Christian Pulisic (USA) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the left post.
42' Christian Pulisic (USA) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
41' Sergino Dest (USA) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
40' Timothy Weah (USA) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
39' Christian Pulisic (USA) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
36' Mason Mount (England) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matt Turner intercepts the ball.
34' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Kieran Trippier (England), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
33' Jesus Valenzuela blows for a foul after Walker Zimmerman (USA) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. England are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
33' It should have been a goal! Christian Pulisic (USA) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
30' John Stones (England) jumps into a tackle and Jesus Valenzuela signals a foul.
29' Yunus Musah (USA) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save.
27' Kieran Trippier (England) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jesus Valenzuela blows for a foul.
26' Weston McKennie (USA) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
25' The foul by Mason Mount (England) was seen by Jesus Valenzuela who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
24' Raheem Sterling (England) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Christian Pulisic (USA) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
20' Sergino Dest (USA) sends a cross into the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off his line to gather the ball.
18' Yunus Musah (USA) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Weston McKennie plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Haji Wright (USA) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot.
16' A pass from Luke Shaw (England) is intercepted by Matt Turner and the move breaks down.
14' Bukayo Saka (England) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
11' Mason Mount (England) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
10' John Stones (England) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
10' Kieran Trippier (England) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
10' Harry Kane (England) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
8' England are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
5' Yunus Musah (USA) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
4' Antonee Robinson (USA) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Luke Shaw (England) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Valenzuela signals.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. England will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jesus Valenzuela.
